description: Responsible for receiving, requisitioning, shipping, warehousing, storing, dispersing and recording parts, equipment and supplies.

Maintains inventory within established specifications and in serviceable condition by following the appropriate procedure to exchange a broken tool, to request repairs, or to requisition additional supplies; reports overdue items and shortages to supervisor.
Experience in inventory, records keeping, and machinery equipment operations.
Responsible for all aspects of airport catering functions, developing and coordinating work schedules for approximately one hundred (100) employee work groups.
Monitors the accuracy of delivery of all scheduled flight meals.
Responsible for the courteous and efficient pick-up and delivery of customer mail and packages.
Ensured all customer information was entered into FedEx systems accurately.
Coordinated daily administrative activities and directly supervised 10 to 15 clerical personnel.
Trained employees on software programs: Word Perfect, Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point.

matchmaking_summary: Phil Simpson is a seasoned Material Logistics Specialist with over ten years of experience in the aviation industry. His comprehensive knowledge and hands-on experience span across all aspects of supply chain management, including shipping/receiving, customer service, safety management, inventory management, records keeping, machinery equipment operations, and more. Notably, he has been instrumental in maintaining high standards for tool exchange, requisitioning additional supplies, and ensuring that all issued equipment is serviceable or repairable. This expertise positions him as a strategic asset in the field of logistics.
